summary: Akanda Corp. filed a Form 6-K to report that it regained compliance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5250(c)(1) after filing its overdue annual report on Form 20-F for fiscal 2025. The press release attached as Exhibit 99.1 details the receipt of a compliance notice from Nasdaq following the late filing. No special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring is involved. This is a routine regulatory compliance update, not a corporate event requiring categorization under the specified special-situation categories.
